Multiplying top and bottom by \(\sqrt{y + x} - \sqrt{y - x}\): \(y' = \dfrac{2y - 2\sqrt{y^2 - x^2}}{2x} = \dfrac{y}{x} - \sqrt{\dfrac{y^2}{x^2} - 1}\). So \(K = \dfrac{y}{x}\).
